title.zh: Chained PHP2Shell exploit roots 25 servers, including US Government servers
title.en: Chained PHP2Shell exploit roots 25 servers, including US Government servers

current_state.zh: A chained PHP2Shell and Linux XFRM ESP-in-TCP exploit was used to root 25 servers, including US government systems, underscoring risks from exposed PHP services and kernel attack surface.
